rlm_payment_outages.question: Summarize all outage reports related to payment failures during the last year and identify recurring root causes.

must_exclude.INC-2026-0712-DRAFT: draft superseded by INC-2026-0712; its preliminary 'network issue' cause is wrong
must_exclude.INC-2026-0611: core banking batch delay, not a payment failure

certificate_lifecycle.summary: Expired client certificates or outdated partner trust chains on mutual-TLS payment connections; monitoring only covered part of the estate

db_connection_pool_exhaustion.summary: payments-ledger ran out of database connections at salary-day or holiday peaks (long reconciliation queries, scaling out pods, N+1 queries)

retry_storm_without_backoff.summary: Immediate or fixed-interval retries without jitter, caps or circuit breakers amplified upstream slowness into outages and duplicate debits

rlm_payment_outages.cross_cutting_observation: Action items were applied narrowly to one integration each time (card switch only, CEFTS client only), so the same failure mode recurred elsewhere.
